tasks.subject: Research pi models.json provider config surface
tasks.description: Find in pi's dist how custom providers are configured (models.json): fields (baseUrl, api, apiKey, headers, models), valid api values, whether apiKey is literal or env var name, and how api keys reach built-in providers. This determines the YAML schema for custard settings.

tasks.subject: Rework backend settings to YAML with validation
tasks.description: Replace form-based Settings with a YAML schema: provider, model, apiKey, bashWhitelist, providers map (baseUrl/api/apiKey/headers/models passthrough). Strict parsing (reject unknown keys), Validate() returning a list of human-readable problems, default template when empty. Update sidecar.go to write models.json + .env into the isolated config dir. Add settings.validate command; settings.save must refuse invalid configs.

tasks.subject: Update protocol (Go + TS) for YAML settings
tasks.description: settings.get → {yaml}, settings.save → {yaml} with validation error response carrying problems[], add CmdSettingsValidate → {valid, problems[]}, settings.updated event carries {yaml}. Mirror in frontend/src/protocol.ts.

tasks.subject: Replace settings form with YAML editor modal
tasks.description: SettingsModal: monospace textarea pre-filled from settings.get, debounced live validation via settings.validate, error list display, Save disabled while invalid, settings.save re-validates authoritatively. Update store.ts (settingsYaml instead of typed settings).
tasks.activeForm: Rewriting settings modal as YAML editor

tasks.subject: Test and ship YAML settings
tasks.description: Unit tests for Validate() (valid config, bad YAML, unknown keys, bad api value, custom provider missing baseUrl, etc.), models.json generation test, full go test + vitest + frontend build, verify against real pi launch probe with a custom provider config, commit.
